baselineDisplay.title: 逃学记录保持者
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】逃学记录保持者
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Did the boy go where he wanted to?
问题：小男孩到了他想要去的地方了吗？
• 词汇准备
• record-holder 纪录保持者
• truant 逃学的孩子
• unimaginative 缺乏想象力的
• shame 惭愧，羞耻
• hitchhike 搭便车旅行
• meantime 其间
• lorry 卡车
• border 边界
• evade 逃避，逃离
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
逃学的孩子们都缺乏想象力。
A quiet day’s fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get.
他们通常能够做到的，至多也就是安静地钓上一天鱼，或在电影院里坐上 8 个小时，一遍遍地看同一部电影。
They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant, travelled 1,600 miles.
而有那么一个小男孩，他在逃学期间旅行了 1,600 英里，从而使上述所有逃学的孩子们都相形见绌了。
He hitchhiked to Dover and, towards evening, went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.
他搭便车到了多佛，天快黑时钻进了一条船，想找个地方睡觉。
When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais. No one noticed the boy as he crept off.
第二天早上他醒来时，发现船在这段时间已经到了加来市。当男孩从船里爬出来时，谁也没有发现他。
From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry. The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
从那里他又搭上卡车到了巴黎。司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，就把他丢在了城外。
The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the center of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
男孩截住的下一辆车，没有像他希望的那样把他带到巴黎市中心，而是把他带到了法国和西班牙边界上的佩皮尼昂。
There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.
他在那儿被一个警察抓住了，之后被当局送回了英国。
He has surely set up a record for the thousands of children who dream of evading school.
他无疑为成千上万想逃学的孩子们创造了一项纪录。
• Step 3: Summary writing.
第三步：摘要写作。
CONNECTIONS POINTS
who 1 Boy played truant.
2 Travelled 1,600 miles.
where 3 Hitchhiked—Dover
only to find 4 Slept—boat
5 Found himself—Calais—morning.
and 6 Lorry driver lift and something to eat.
7 Boy got off near Paris.
but 8 Stopped another car.
instead of being 9 Not taken to Paris—Perpignan
After 10 Picked up—policeman.
11 Sent home—authorities.
Answer: A boy who played truant travelled 1,600 miles. He hitchhiked to Dover where he slept in a boat, only to find himself in Calais the next morning. A lorry driver gave him a lift and something to eat, and the boy got off near Paris. He stopped another car but, instead of being taken to Paris, he was taken to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border. After being picked up by a policeman, he was sent home by the local authorities.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1 How did the boy get to Dover?
(a) He walked.
(b) He went by train.
(c) Someone gave him a lift.
(d) He went in lorry
2 The boy ________.
(a) didn't expect to be taken to Perpignan
(b) decided to go to Perpignan
(c) went to Paris
(d) wanted to go to Spain
3 __________ did he travel? 1,600 miles.
(a) How long
(b) How long ago
(c) How much further
(d) How far
4 How did he get to Dover?
(a) By hitchhiking.
(b) With hitchhike.
(c) Hitchhiking.
(d) With hitchhiking.
5 He wasn't noticed by _______ as he crept off the boat.
(a) no one
(b) none
(c) anyone
(d) not one
6 The driver gave him a few biscuits. ________ was given a few biscuits.
(a) To him
(b) Him
(c) For him
(d) He
7 After ________ by policeman, he was sent back to England.
(a) being picked up
(b) he picked up
(c) been picked up
(d) picking up
8 Little boys who play truant don't go to school _________.
(a) because they are ill
(b) because they have left
(c) because they are not allowed to
(d) on purpose
9 They are unimaginative. They haven't much _________.
(a) imagination
(b) fantasy
(c) imaginary
(d) fantasia
10 They have been put to shame by a boy. They should feel ________.
(a) ashamed
(b) shy
(c) shyness
(d) shameful
11 He was picked up by a policeman. A policeman ________ him.
(a) gathered
(b) collected
(c) assembled
(d) found
12 Thousands of boys dream of evading school. They dream of ________ it.
(a) escaping
(b) avoiding
(c) preventing
(d) running away
Key: 1 c 2 a 3 d 4 a 5 c 6 d 7 a 8 d 9 a 10 a 11 d 12 b
第五十七单元【语法点拨】 强调
▶ 强调结构的构成形式是：It+ be +被强调成分+that/who…。
• Albert Einstein advanced the theory of relativity at the beginning of the last century.
艾尔伯特·爱因斯坦于上世纪初提出了相对论。(正常结构)
• It was Albert Einstein who/that advanced the theory of relativity at the beginning of the last century. (强调主语)
• It was the theory of relativity that Albert Einstein advanced at the beginning of the last century. (强调宾语)
• It was at the beginning of the last century that Albert Einstein advanced the theory of relativity. (强调时间状语)
▶ 使用强调句型应注意的几个问题:
▪ 不能强调谓语动词，而要用 do, did 来加强语气。
• I do hope you will succeed in the experiment. 我真希望你试验成功。
• Tom did buy a new computer yesterday. 汤姆昨天的确买了一台新计算机。
▪ 一般不强调表语，但可以强调宾语补语。
• They elected him president of the university. 他们推举他为该大学校长。
• It was president of the university that they elected him.
• He has painted the door red. 他已经把门漆成红色。
• It is red that he has painted the door.
▪ 不能强调 since 或 as 引导的原因状语从句，也不能强调 although 或 whereas 引导的让步状语从句或并列句，但可以强调 because 引导的原因状语从句。
• It was just because she had forgotten to wind the alarm clock that Mary was late.
正是因为玛丽忘记给闹钟上发条所以她迟到了。
▪ 凡是强调状语，如时间状语、地点状语、方式状语等，只能用 that，而不用 which, when 或 where。
• It is from the sun that we get light and heat.
从太阳那里我们得到了光和热。
• It is in this city that scientists have done lot to stop pollution.
正是在这个城市，科学家们已经做了大量的工作来制止污染。
▪ It is/was not until...that...强调时间的常用句型，可译为“直到……才……”。
• It was not until the 19th century that heat was considered a form of energy.
直到 19 世纪，热能才被认为是能量的一种形式。
上句也可以换成部分倒装结构:
• Not until the 19th century was heat considered a form of energy.
▪ 被强调的句子的谓语动词如果是过去时，强调结构中的谓语动词 be 一般只能用 was，而不可用 is。
• I did not get your letter until yesterday. 直到昨天我才收到你的来信。
• It was not until yesterday that I got your letter.
▪ 在下面句子中， 通常用 It has been+ 时间 +since…, 而不用强调句 It is…that...。
• I have not seen you for three years.
• It has been three years since I last saw you. 我已经三年未见到你了。

▪ 突出原因时，常用 It is/was because ... that ...。since、as 引导的背景原因通常不放在这个焦点位置；although、whereas 等引导的让步或对比关系，也不能直接机械套用该原因强调结构。

▪ 在这里介绍的标准 it-cleft 中，强调时间、地点、方式等状语时通常用 that 连接后半句，不应因被强调的是时间或地点就机械换成 when/where。

blocks.text: 【故事复现】逃学记录保持者
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Did the boy go where he wanted to?
问题：小男孩到了他想要去的地方了吗？
• 词汇准备
• record-holder 纪录保持者
• truant 逃学的孩子
• unimaginative 缺乏想象力的
• shame 惭愧，羞耻
• hitchhike 搭便车旅行
• meantime 其间
• lorry 卡车
• border 边界
• evade 逃避，逃离
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。

Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
逃学的孩子们都缺乏想象力。
A quiet day’s fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get.
他们通常能够做到的，至多也就是安静地钓上一天鱼，或在电影院里坐上 8 个小时，一遍遍地看同一部电影。
They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant, travelled 1,600 miles.
而有那么一个小男孩，他在逃学期间旅行了 1,600 英里，从而使上述所有逃学的孩子们都相形见绌了。
He hitchhiked to Dover and, towards evening, went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.
他搭便车到了多佛，天快黑时钻进了一条船，想找个地方睡觉。
When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais. No one noticed the boy as he crept off.
第二天早上他醒来时，发现船在这段时间已经到了加来市。当男孩从船里爬出来时，谁也没有发现他。
From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry. The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
从那里他又搭上卡车到了巴黎。司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，就把他丢在了城外。
The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the center of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan near the French-Spanish border.
男孩截住的下一辆车，没有像他希望的那样把他带到巴黎市中心，而是把他带到了法国和西班牙边界附近的佩皮尼昂。
There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.
他在那儿被一个警察抓住了，之后被当局送回了英国。
He has surely set up a record for the thousands of children who dream of evading school.
他无疑为成千上万想逃学的孩子们创造了一项纪录。
• Step 3: Summary writing.
第三步：摘要写作。
CONNECTIONS POINTS

who 1 Boy played truant.
2 Travelled 1,600 miles.
where 3 Hitchhiked—Dover

only to find 4 Slept—boat
5 Found himself—Calais—morning.

and 6 Lorry driver lift and something to eat.
7 Boy got off near Paris.
but 8 Stopped another car.
instead of being 9 Not taken to Paris—Perpignan

After 10 Picked up—policeman.
11 Sent home—authorities.

Answer: A boy who played truant travelled 1,600 miles. He hitchhiked to Dover where he slept in a boat, only to find himself in Calais the next morning. A lorry driver gave him a lift and something to eat, and the boy got off near Paris. He stopped another car but, instead of being taken to Paris, he was taken to Perpignan near the French-Spanish border. After being picked up by a policeman, he was sent home by the local authorities.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。

(d) He

(a) being picked up
(b) he picked up
(c) been picked up
(d) picking up

(a) because they are ill

第五十七单元【语法点拨】 强调
▶ 强调结构的构成形式是：It+ be +被强调成分+that/who…。

• Albert Einstein advanced the theory of relativity at the beginning of the twentieth century.
艾尔伯特·爱因斯坦于二十世纪初提出了相对论。(正常结构)
• It was Albert Einstein who/that advanced the theory of relativity at the beginning of the twentieth century. (强调主语)
• It was the theory of relativity that Albert Einstein advanced at the beginning of the twentieth century. (强调宾语)
• It was at the beginning of the twentieth century that Albert Einstein advanced the theory of relativity. (强调时间状语)
▶ 使用强调句型应注意的几个问题:
▪ 若强调谓语动作本身，一般不把限定谓语直接填入 it-cleft 的焦点位置；可用 do/does/did 加动词原形，或借助 what ... do ... 结构。
• I do hope you will succeed in the experiment. 我真希望你试验成功。
• Tom did buy a new computer yesterday. 汤姆昨天的确买了一台新计算机。
▪ 表语或宾语补语不宜机械套用 it-cleft。有些补语前置强调带有很强的语境限制；学习表达时，可用 what ... do ... 结构突出整个动作和结果。
• They elected him president of the university. 他们推举他为该大学校长。

• What they did was elect him president of the university.
他们所做的就是推举他担任大学校长。
• He has painted the door red. 他已经把门漆成红色。

• What he has done is paint the door red.
他所做的就是把门漆成红色。
▪ 突出原因时，常用 It is/was because ... that ...。since、as 引导的背景原因通常不放在这个焦点位置；although、whereas 等引导的让步或对比关系，也不能直接机械套用该原因强调结构。

• It was just because she had forgotten to wind the alarm clock that Mary was late.
正是因为玛丽忘记给闹钟上发条所以她迟到了。
▪ 在这里介绍的标准 it-cleft 中，强调时间、地点、方式等状语时通常用 that 连接后半句，不应因被强调的是时间或地点就机械换成 when/where。

• It is from the sun that we get light and heat.
从太阳那里我们得到了光和热。

• It is in this city that scientists have done a lot to stop pollution.
正是在这个城市，科学家们已经做了大量的工作来制止污染。
▪ It is/was not until...that...强调时间的常用句型，可译为“直到……才……”。

• It was not until Monday that the new timetable was announced.
直到星期一，新的时间表才公布。
上句也可以换成部分倒装结构:
• Not until Monday was the new timetable announced.
▪ 叙述过去的事件时，强调结构通常用 was；若强调的是现在仍成立的身份或判断，也可以用 is 配过去时从句。不能规定后半句为过去时就绝对不可用 is。
• I did not get your letter until yesterday. 直到昨天我才收到你的来信。
• It was not until yesterday that I got your letter.
▪ 表示距离上次见面已有多久，通常用 It has been / It is + 时间 + since ...；这与突出某个成分的 it-cleft 不是同一种结构。
• I have not seen you for three years.
• It has been three years since I last saw you. 我已经三年未见到你了。
